title: People & Payments
headline: Know who worked, who's owed, who's paid.
subhead: Clear records replace memory across labor, sub-contractors, and material suppliers.
description: Mark attendance without signal, track contractor advances against verified work, and see vendor balances at a glance.
bulletPoints: Workforce: Attendance is marked per worker, per site — full or half day. Each day's wage posts to the site's cost automatically.
Contractors: Advance payments and expenses recorded per contractor, per site. A dedicated report shows commitments, advances and remaining balances.
Vendors: Cash and credit purchases are tracked separately. Outstanding balances are visible at a glance, and settlements apply to oldest bills first.
